page.layout: One column of running text, set in the centre of the page. Running head at the top, centred. No page number, no signature. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: te: Hactenus scripsi ad opinionem, nunc
scribam ad veritatem. Quasi dicat, so-
sunt à Deo datæ, vt discamus inde
quæ hinc inde sunt ibi sparsa. Leui-
rabolarum, quæ in Bibliis ex herbis
quâ [illegible, ~2 letters] ratione singula loca expla-

page.notes: The word between "quâ" and "ratione" is partly covered by a light smudge on the scan; the reading "in" is likely but not certain, so it is marked illegible. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The catchword is read as "cam," from the lower right. No page number or signature is printed. Faint show-through in the lower half of the page is not transcribed.
